name: study3_med_requests
title: Medication requests used by the study 3 condition criteria
description: Blood-glucose-lowering drug prescriptions (ATC A10A and A10B), with the dosing start time shifted 3 days earlier so that prescriptions registered shortly after an outpatient visit still fall inside the feature window

entity.name: pid
entity.description: A unique identifier assigned to each patient in the cohort.

entity.name: encounterId
entity.description: A unique identifier for each hospital encounter.

feature.name: medicationGroups
feature.title: Medication groups
feature.description: Medication groups to be used when specific ATC codes are not available.

feature.name: joinTime
feature.title: MedicationRequest start time shifted 3 days earlier
feature.description: The MedicationRequest start time shifted 3 days earlier. Used as the event time of this feature group so that records registered up to 3 days after the reference time point still fall inside the feature window. This is not the real time - use startTime for that.

feature.name: joinEndTime
feature.title: MedicationRequest end time shifted 3 days earlier
feature.description: The MedicationRequest end time shifted 3 days earlier, so that it stays consistent with joinTime. Used as the event time end of this feature group. This is not the real time - use endTime for that.
